requirement: Any recommended practices, guidance or standards contained in this document should be... used in accordance with... all applicable laws, regulations and recommended practices addressing safety and regulatory compliance (such as OSHA and ANSI requirements).
scope: Company operations and maintenance practices

requirement: Filter efficiency is determined by ISO 16889.
scope: Laboratory testing and rating of full-flow gear oil filters for wind turbines.

requirement: high voltage tests should only be performed by a trained generator test technician.
scope: Generator high voltage electrical testing during maintenance.
related_domains: personnel qualification; operational safety; electrical maintenance

related_domains: grid integration; electrical safety; component resilience

requirement: Documentation on the hub should include conformity to the manufacturer’s engineering drawings.
scope: Hub component documentation, Pre-Purchase Audit phase
related_domains: quality assurance; component integrity; procurement

requirement: Immediately following an environmental incident a ground based visual inspection for obvious hub damage should be conducted.
scope: Hub component, Operational phase, post-environmental incident

requirement: The LP system conforms to its original design and functionality.
scope: Wind turbine lightning protection (LP) system, during the lifetime of the wind turbine.
related_domains: system integrity; maintenance; lightning protection; operational safety

scope: Wind turbine lightning protection (LP) system, during the lifetime of the wind turbine.
related_domains: system integrity; maintenance; lightning protection; asset management

requirement: Operational data listed in Table A must be collected in order to produce key performance indicators. This includes: MW, Turbine Available, Turbine Online, Turbine Fault Code, Wind Speed, Wind Direction, and Curtailment Events.
scope: Operational phase of wind farm plant and turbines
related_domains: data collection; performance monitoring; operational reporting

requirement: The wind park must be kept producing in an acceptable range in terms of both MW and MVAR output as defined by any interconnection agreements, ISO curtailments, etc.
scope: Operational phase - Wind park power output
related_domains: grid integration; power plant control; operational compliance

requirement: The SCADA connection to the interconnecting utility is required to be fully operational before permission to back feed is granted.
scope: Operational phase, specifically the SCADA system interface at the Point of Interconnection (POI).
related_domains: grid interconnection; SCADA systems; commissioning; operational readiness

requirement: Bollards/fences shall be installed and in good operational condition to protect from vehicle and large animal intrusion to the outer enclosure.
scope: Pad Mount Transformer (PMT) enclosures
related_domains: site security; asset protection; operational safety

requirement: Energized operational tests should be conducted in accordance with International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC) and/or American Society for Testing Materials (ASTM) standards using appropriate safety equipment.

source: International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC) and/or American Society for Testing Materials (ASTM) standards
related_domains: operational testing; equipment maintenance; electrical safety; standards compliance

requirement: The alternative method for main bearing grease sampling with a drain access plug must follow the guidance provided in ASTM D7718, Section 10.
scope: Wind Turbine Main Bearing Grease Sampling
related_domains: maintenance procedures; component integrity; condition monitoring

requirement: The quantification of metallic elements in grease using the inductively coupled plasma (ICP) method is governed by ASTM D7303.
scope: Operational phase, grease analysis using the ICP method.
related_domains: operations and maintenance; condition monitoring; materials analysis

requirement: For a 1.5 MW generator with a service factor of 1.15 and insulation class B, the maximum allowable temperature rise is 95°C based on a maximum ambient temperature of 40°C. A warning condition should be alerted when the winding temperature is greater than 135°C.
scope: Generator windings during operational phase
related_domains: condition monitoring; equipment integrity; operational safety

requirement: An off-line 50/60 Hz PD (partial discharge) test with better than 5 pC sensitivity is required to determine whether or not components are in or out of specification.
scope: Modern solid dielectric components for medium and high voltage cable systems on wind farms, typically performed during construction and periodically during plant shutdowns.
related_domains: component testing; quality assurance; electrical systems; cable integrity
